notes.title: Minor bug fixes. Camera improvements
notes.notes:
Moved the camera a bit further back. This will help you to see where you are going.
Updated how the timer information is saved.

notes.title: Version 1.23
notes.notes:
This version allows the grapple torches to be seen easier.
The last levels were still a bit too difficult to complete on easy mode, so they are now easier.
Lastly, in the install directory (where the executable of this game resides), there is a new folder that has all of the tracks for this game including one track that was never used.

notes.title: Release for V1.2
notes.notes:
Full Controller Support
More fairness for level 28 and level 3
9 languages to choose from
player no longer gets stuck on edges

notes.title: Demon Runner Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Change Log:
Player no longer gets stuck on edges while jumping.
Full controller support
reworked how fire acts from the fire jets.
made level 28 a bit more 'fair'
Now has 9 languages to choose from.

notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.notes: This update fixes the issue with choosing the difficulty when starting a new game.  It also fixes the issue with the world map when clicking on the next/preview buttons. An additional fix for purchasing powerups while using an Xbox controller has also been implemented. Unfortunately, there is no controller support for the main menu or world map. However, Blue Slayer Gaming will work at getting support added back in the main menu and world map as soon as possible.
